Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that installs Docker (apt or yum source), adds a specified user to the docker group, and ensures the docker daemon is running and enabled at boot.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Install and configure Docker
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    docker_user: "{{ lookup('env', 'DOCKER_USER') | default('deploy', true) }}"
    docker_compose_plugin: true
    docker_apt_gpg_key_url: "https://download.docker.com/linux/{{ ansible_distribution | lower }}/gpg"
    docker_apt_repo: "deb [arch={{ deb_arch | default('amd64') }} signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/{{ ansible_distribution | lower }} {{ ansible_distribution_release }} stable"
    docker_yum_repo_url: "https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/docker-ce.repo"
    docker_packages:
      - docker-ce
      - docker-ce-cli
      - containerd.io
      - docker-buildx-plugin
      - docker-compose-plugin

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Ensure target user exists
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ docker_user }}"
        state: present
        shell: /bin/bash
        create_home: true

    - name: Determine dpkg architecture (Debian/Ubuntu)
      ansible.builtin.command: dpkg --print-architecture
      register: dpkg_arch
      changed_when: false
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Set deb_arch fact
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        deb_arch: "{{ dpkg_arch.stdout }}"
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

  tasks:
    # -------------------- Debian / Ubuntu --------------------
    - name: Install prerequisites (Debian family)
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name:
          - ca-certificates
          - curl
          - gnupg
          - lsb-release
          - apt-transport-https
        state: present
        update_cache: true
        cache_valid_time: 3600
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Ensure apt keyrings directory exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /etc/apt/keyrings
        state: directory
        mode: "0755"
        owner: root
        group: root
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Add Docker official GPG key (Debian family)
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "{{ docker_apt_gpg_key_url }}"
        dest: /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
        mode: "0644"
        owner: root
        group: root
        force: false
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Add Docker apt repository (Debian family)
      ansible.builtin.apt_repository:
        repo: "{{ docker_apt_repo }}"
        state: present
        filename: docker
        update_cache: true
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Install Docker Engine (Debian family)
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name: "{{ docker_packages }}"
        state: present
        update_cache: true
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    # -------------------- RHEL / CentOS / Rocky / Alma --------------------
    - name: Install prerequisites (RedHat family)
      ansible.builtin.yum:
        name:
          - yum-utils
          - device-mapper-persistent-data
          - lvm2
        state: present
      when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"

    - name: Add Docker yum repository (RedHat family)
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "{{ docker_yum_repo_url }}"
        dest: /etc/yum.repos.d/docker-ce.repo
        mode: "0644"
        owner: root
        group: root
      when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"

    - name: Install Docker Engine (RedHat family)
      ansible.builtin.package:
        name: "{{ docker_packages }}"
        state: present
      when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"

    # -------------------- Common --------------------
    - name: Ensure /etc/docker directory exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /etc/docker
        state: directory
        mode: "0755"
        owner: root
        group: root

    - name: Deploy secure docker daemon configuration
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/docker/daemon.json
        mode: "0644"
        owner: root
        group: root
        content: |
          {
            "log-driver": "json-file",
            "log-opts": {
              "max-size": "10m",
              "max-file": "3"
            },
            "live-restore": true,
            "userland-proxy": false,
            "no-new-privileges": true,
            "icc": false
          }
      notify: Restart docker

    - name: Ensure docker group exists
      ansible.builtin.group:
        name: docker
        state: present

    - name: Add user to docker group
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ docker_user }}"
        groups: docker
        append: true

    - name: Ensure docker service is enabled and running
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: docker
        state: started
        enabled: true
        daemon_reload: true

    - name: Ensure containerd service is enabled and running
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: containerd
        state: started
        enabled: true

    - name: Verify Docker installation
      ansible.builtin.command: docker --version
      register: docker_version
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display Docker version
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "Installed: {{ docker_version.stdout }}"

  handlers:
    - name: Restart docker
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: docker
        state: restarted
        daemon_reload: true
